tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind every panel. The ground of the window and of the control-plane pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, worker tiles, tables. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, menus, popovers, the command bar, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Terminals, log streams, code and input wells. Always sits inside a surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers between rows and panels. Decorative only, never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons) and the meter track edge. Meets 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, labels, column headers on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders and disabled labels on canvas, surface and surface-sunken. Still 4.5:1.

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: The brand. Primary button fill, the active nav marker, the selected worker edge, the cover. Used once per view, never as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: volt-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a volt or volt-hover fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: volt-text
tokens.usage: Brand-colored text and links on canvas and surface; the focus ring color.

tokens.name: volt-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row and selected nav item fill. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a solid 2px outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Worker state Running: dot, icon and label text on surface and surface-raised. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: running-soft
tokens.usage: Running status pill fill. Its label uses running.

tokens.name: provisioning
tokens.usage: Worker state Provisioning or Booting, and informational notices. Paired with the word and a spinner.

tokens.name: provisioning-soft
tokens.usage: Provisioning status pill fill.

tokens.name: draining
tokens.usage: Worker state Draining or Stopping, and warnings (spot interruption notice, quota near). Paired with the word.

tokens.name: draining-soft
tokens.usage: Draining status pill fill.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Worker state Failed and destructive actions' text. Paired with the word and a warning icon.

tokens.name: failed-soft
tokens.usage: Failed status pill fill and the destructive button's hover fill.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Worker state Idle or Stopped. Same weight as ink-muted, paired with the word.

tokens.name: idle-soft
tokens.usage: Idle status pill fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the command bar and dialogs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One number or headline per page: the fleet count on Overview, the cover. Never in panels.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside panels, card titles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, metadata under a title, helper text under a field.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text in small buttons, pill text.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Instance IDs, worker names, regions, AMI IDs, commands, log lines. Identifiers only, never labels.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Aligned numbers in tables and meters (CPU, cost, uptime).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase region and section tags above a title. At most one per panel.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, dot to word in a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; dense row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding; text inset from a card edge (the minimum).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page; dialog padding; dot-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page bands (header to content).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills' inner dot wells, small icon buttons, checkboxes, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, list row hover fills.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, worker tiles, the command bar, terminals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and meters only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, popovers, the command bar, toasts. Cards stay flat on borders.
